# BUYER BLOCK BOOKING – ON ORDER ADJUSTMENT

###### ​​

###### Contents
BUYER BLOCK BOOKING – ON ORDER ADJUSTMENT 1
Scope 3
Purpose 3
Solution 3
Projection Order BBB 3
Confirmed Order 3

# Scope

# Purpose

# Solution

## Projection Order BBB
Created a Buyer Block Booking of Projection type, entered the required booking details, linked the materials associated with the article, and confirmed the Buyer Block Booking
Adhoc indent
Created an Adhoc Indent against Buyer Block Booking of Projection type to generate the material requirement for procurement.
RMPO
Created an RMPO for a quantity of 400 units through the Indent to fulfill the material requirement.
GRN
Created a Goods Receipt Note (GRN) against the RMPO and recorded the receipt of 200 units.
In House Adjustment
Added 200 units to In House stock through stock correction and allocated 100 units to the Indent through In House Adjustment.
Adhoc RMPO
Created an Adhoc RMPO for 250 units to fulfill the material requirement.
On order Adjustment
Added 250 units to On Order stock and allocated 150 units to the Indent through On Order Adjustment.
Current Functionality
Step 1: Projection Buyer Block Booking
The user creates a Buyer Block Booking (BBB) with Type = Projection for a quantity of 1000.
An Adhoc Indent of 1000 is generated, and the following transactions are performed:
• RMPO created for 400 Qty
• GRN completed against RMPO for 200 Qty
• In-House Adjustment done for 100 Qty (out of 200)
• On-Order Adjustment done for 150 Qty (out of 250)

## Confirmed Order
Created and confirmed the order by linking the Projection Buyer Block Booking.
After confirming the order and generating the MRL, the indent is created, and the remaining quantities from the previously created adhoc indent—100 (in-house) and 200 (GRN)—are adjusted as in-house.
Current Functionality
The user creates a Confirmed Sales Order for 1000 Qty by linking the Projection Buyer Block Booking.
But no auto adjustments were made except in-house, so we done them manually like this

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 4 rows · columns: Activity (text), Qty (text), Details (text) · identifiers: Activity]
| Activity | Qty | Details |
| RMPO Created | 400 Qty | RMPO generated for 400 units |
| GRN Completed | 200 Qty | Auto Unreserve and then Auto adjust as In House |
| In-House Adjustment | 100 Qty (of 200) | Auto unreserve and Auto adjust as In-House Adjustment |
| On-Order Adjustment | 150 Qty (of 250) | On-order stock Manually adjusted from previous adhoc indent RMPO |
To-Be Process
The user creates a Confirmed Sales Order for 1000 Qty by linking the Reservation Buyer Block Booking.
The system shall automatically carry forward the same adjustments to the Confirmed Sales Order as follows:

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 4 rows · columns: Previous Transaction (text), Auto Adjustment in Confirmed Sales Order (text) · identifiers: Previous Transaction]
| Previous Transaction | Auto Adjustment in Confirmed Sales Order |
| RMPO created (200 Qty) | Auto adjust as On Order |
| GRN against RMPO (150 Qty) | Auto Unreserve and then Auto adjust as In House (currently working) |
| In-House Adjustment (150 Qty) | Auto unreserve and Auto adjust as In-House Adjustment (currently working) |
| On-Order Adjustment (200 Qty) | Auto adjust as On-Order Adjustment |
